title.zh: 将民多罗省1904年度土地税缴纳期限延长至1904年10月31日的法案
title.en: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCE OF MINDORO FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR UNTIL OCTOBER THIRTY-FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR.
title.orig: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCE OF MINDORO FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR UNTIL OCTOBER THIRTY-FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR.
title.vi: Luật gia hạn thời hạn nộp thuế đất năm 1904 tại tỉnh Mindoro đến ngày 31-10-1904
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติขยายกำหนดเวลาชำระภาษีที่ดินปี 1904 ในจังหวัด Mindoro ถึงวันที่ 31 ตุลาคม 1904
title.id: Undang-Undang memperpanjang batas pembayaran pajak tanah tahun 1904 di Provinsi Mindoro hingga 31 Oktober 1904
title.ms: Akta melanjutkan tempoh pembayaran cukai tanah tahun 1904 di wilayah Mindoro hingga 31 Oktober 1904

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_01206_1904_html.txt

text.en:
The period, for the payment, without penalty, of the land tax for the year nineteen hundred and
four in the Province of Mindoro is hereby extended to October thirty-first, nineteen hundred and four.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this lull, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, July 26, 1904.
